description: Branch R-SORT-3 Floating and DATE (SQL consumers of negative zero) on an ACCDB. NZ(ID, D Double, S Single, T Date) with rows -0, +0, 1 and Null written as VT_R8, VT_R4 and VT_DATE bit patterns. The index walks earlier ordered -0 before +0 and Seek told them apart; this asks what SQL does: WHERE D = 0, D < 0, D > 0, S = 0, CDbl(T) = 0, ORDER BY D, ID, GROUP BY D, SELECT DISTINCT D, and an index IX_D built afterwards with the same reads. Asks whether SQL equality, grouping and ordering treat -0 and +0 as one value.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
